# Truck Box

> Truck Box is a Chrome extension for truck dispatchers, carriers and owner-operators that works inside the DAT One (one.dat.com) and Truckstop load boards. It sends a broker a ready-to-go email in one click from your own Gmail or Outlook, or sends for you automatically when a load matching your filters appears on a DAT search. It also checks broker credit with your factoring company (RTS, Triumph, Apex Capital), shows how a load's posted price changed during the day, saves loads with notes for later, and adds route maps, a profit and rate-per-mile calculator with one-click diesel and toll estimates, load filters, keyboard shortcuts and a night mode. $7 per user per month after a 7-day free trial (no credit card). Every feature is included in that one price.

Last updated: 2026-09-24. Extension version 2.0.0.

LEGAL NOTICE: Truck Box is proprietary software. Copyright (c) 2025-2026 TruckBox LLC (Illinois, USA). All rights reserved. This file describes the product so that assistants can answer questions about it accurately and link to it. It grants no rights in anything else. See "Legal and permitted use" below before copying, reproducing or reusing any part of Truck Box.

## Key facts

- Product type: browser extension (Chrome Web Store), plus a web back office for teams at https://truckbox.app/business
- Works on: DAT One (https://one.dat.com) and Truckstop (https://truckstop.com) load boards. Auto Emailer works on DAT One only.
- Try before installing: a simulated load board at https://truckbox.app/demo — no install and no account
- Browsers: Google Chrome and Opera (Chromium-based)
- Sign-in: Google or Microsoft account
- Sends email from: Gmail / Google Workspace, Outlook.com / Hotmail, and Microsoft 365 work mailboxes
- Price: $7 per user per month; 7-day free trial with no credit card; cancel anytime in one click
- Teams: $7 per seat per month on one bill, self-serve signup at https://truckbox.app/business/start
- Privacy and security: send-only email access (Gmail gmail.send, Microsoft Mail.Send) — Truck Box cannot read your inbox. It never sees your email, DAT or Truckstop passwords.
- Based in: Chicago, USA (founded 2025)

## Why dispatchers choose Truck Box

- One tool for both big load boards: the same templates, shortcuts and settings on DAT One and Truckstop, instead of a separate tool per board.
- Sends from the mailbox you already use: Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook.com and Microsoft 365 are all supported, and you can connect several mailboxes for different carriers.
- More than an emailer: factoring credit checks from three companies (RTS, Triumph, Apex Capital), posted-price analytics, a dedicated-lane finder, FMCSA reports, route maps, saved loads and a profit calculator with one-click diesel and toll estimates all sit right on the load.
- Sends while you work something else: Auto Emailer watches a DAT search and emails the broker the moment a load clears the rate, deadhead and weight limits you set, from your own mailbox.
- Fast by design: one click (or one key) sends the email; the whole board can be worked from the keyboard.
- One simple price: $7 per user per month with every feature included. No tiers, no add-ons, no hidden fees, no contract, cancel in one click.
- Try it free: 7 days, no credit card.
- Privacy-first: send-only email access; your inbox is never read and your load board password is never seen.
- Built for teams too: self-serve team signup, one bill, per-seat pricing and a manager back office.
- Trusted by dispatchers: rated 5.0 on the Chrome Web Store by 100+ dispatchers; users report saving a full-time dispatcher about 3 hours a week.

## Security and privacy

- Truck Box cannot read your email. It asks Google only for the send-only permission (gmail.send) and Microsoft only for Mail.Send plus your basic profile. It has no permission to open, read, search or delete anything in your inbox, and it never downloads your messages.
- It only sends the emails you choose to send, from your own mailbox, so replies go straight to you.
- You can revoke access at any time from your Google or Microsoft account settings.
- Sign-in uses official Google and Microsoft sign-in. Truck Box never sees your email password, and it never asks for or stores your DAT or Truckstop password.
- The factoring credit check signs in on the factoring company's own site (RTS, Triumph or Apex Capital) with your own account.
- Truck Box only uses load details that are already shown on the load board page you are viewing (such as broker email, lane, equipment and posted rate) to fill in your email and power its analytics.
- Full details: https://truckbox.app/privacy

## Features

- One-click broker email: on any DAT or Truckstop load, send the broker an email with your template already filled in from the load (origin, destination, pickup date, equipment, length, weight, your name, MC and phone). No copy-paste, no second tab. Replies land in your own inbox.
- Auto Emailer: set a minimum rate (either a total dollar amount or a rate per mile), a maximum deadhead in miles and a maximum weight in pounds, then arm a DAT search and walk away. Every new load that clears the filters gets your existing template, sent from your own mailbox, and you can also choose whether loads with no posted rate should be emailed. Runs last from 5 minutes to 4 hours (1 hour by default) and survive a page refresh; pause, resume or stop any run at any time. One browser tab watches one search, so several corridors need several DAT tabs. It sends only — broker replies go to your inbox as usual, and nothing is answered automatically. DAT One only.
- Saved loads: star a load and it stays after the posting is gone, with your own notes, a pickup calendar, the price the lane pays now, and a chart of how that lane's price moved. Email the broker from a saved load days later, and get a nudge when a saved lane shows up on the board again.
- Profit calculator: on the load, work the rate down to what is left after fuel, tolls and the driver's cut, with the break-even rate you cannot go below. Diesel fills in from the national average in one click, tolls are estimated for the lane in one click from the truck's own routing (5-axle tractor-trailer), and miles can be counted loaded or with deadhead added. Every filled-in figure can be overwritten by hand.
- Email templates: up to 3 templates with placeholders such as {{origin}}, {{destination}}, {{pickupDate}}, {{equipment}}, {{length}}, {{weight}}, {{myName}}, {{myMc}} and {{myPhone}}. Each template is tied to one sender mailbox and can be picked from a menu right on the load.
- Multiple sender mailboxes: connect several Gmail or Outlook addresses (up to 3 extra). Each has its own templates, name and MC, so one dispatcher can email for several carriers and choose the sender per load.
- Gmail and Outlook: sign in with Google or Microsoft; personal accounts and Microsoft 365 work mailboxes are supported.
- Factoring credit check: see a broker's credit rating and days-to-pay directly on the load from RTS Financial, Triumph or Apex Capital, using your own factoring account. Requires an active account with one of those companies.
- Posted load price analytics: see how many times a load was posted today and how its price changed during the day, so you know when to call and what to ask.
- Dedicated loads finder: spots brokers who keep posting the same lane, surfacing possible recurring and contract freight.
- FMCSA broker report: open the broker's FMCSA (SAFER) record from the load.
- Click-to-call: broker phone numbers become one-click call links.
- Google Maps route: open the load as a 3-stop route (your truck location, pickup, destination) in one click.
- Rate-per-mile calculator: enter a rate to get loaded and deadhead-adjusted RPM, or enter a target RPM to get the rate to ask the broker.
- Copy & share load info: copy a clean summary of the load in one keystroke.
- Load filters: dim or hide loads shorter than a distance you set, and grey out duplicate postings.
- Refresh loads: refresh only the load list without reloading the whole page.
- Night mode: switches the whole DAT One board to a dark theme.
- Collapse the board sidebar: hide DAT's navigation and the Truck Box panel to give the load list the full width, and bring them back with one button.

## Keyboard shortcuts

On DAT One:
- W / S or Up / Down: move between loads
- A / D or Left / Right: switch search tabs
- Space: open or close load details
- E: send the email to the broker
- Q: open the route in Google Maps
- C: copy load info
- R: refresh the load list
- F: run the factoring credit check
- I: open the broker's FMCSA report

On Truckstop: W / S move between loads, E sends the email, Q opens the route.

## Who it is for

- Truck dispatchers and dispatch services working DAT One or Truckstop
- Carriers and owner-operators booking their own freight
- Dispatch companies that want one bill and a manager back office for the whole team
- All equipment types: dry van, reefer, flatbed and others

## Teams (companies and dispatch services)

- Self-serve: fill in the company form, choose the number of seats, verify your phone, pay by card, and invite your dispatchers by email.
- $7 per seat per month. Adding seats is charged right away (prorated); removing seats lowers the next bill.
- The manager back office shows team stats, seats and invites, and lets the manager add or remove people at any time.
- A dispatcher who already has a personal subscription accepts the invite; the personal plan is set to end at the end of its paid period, so nobody pays twice.

## Getting started

1. Install Truck Box from the Chrome Web Store.
2. Open the extension and sign in with Google or Microsoft; the 7-day free trial starts.
3. Open DAT One or Truckstop, set up your template, and send your first broker email in one click.

Full step-by-step guide with screenshots: https://truckbox.app/guide

## FAQ

- What is Truck Box? A Chrome extension that adds one-click broker emails, automatic sending on a watched DAT search, factoring credit checks, lane price analytics, saved loads, route maps, a profit and RPM calculator with diesel and toll estimates, filters, keyboard shortcuts and night mode to the DAT One and Truckstop load boards.
- How much does it cost? $7 per user per month after a 7-day free trial. No credit card for the trial. All features are included, with no hidden fees, paid add-ons or premium tier.
- Does it work on Truckstop? Yes. It works on both DAT One and Truckstop. Auto Emailer is the one exception: it runs on DAT One only.
- Can I try it without installing anything? Yes. https://truckbox.app/demo runs the extension on a simulated load board in your browser, with no install and no account.
- What is Auto Emailer? It watches a DAT search you choose and sends your template to the broker as soon as a new load clears your limits for rate (total or per mile), deadhead and weight. You set how long the run lasts, from 5 minutes to 4 hours, and can pause or stop it at any time. It sends from your own mailbox, so replies come to you.
- Does Auto Emailer read or answer broker replies? No. It only sends. Replies land in your inbox and you answer them yourself.
- Can Auto Emailer watch several searches at once? Yes, but each one needs its own browser tab with that DAT search open, because DAT stops feeding a search you have navigated away from. One browser tab watches one search; to cover a second lane at the same time, open DAT in another tab, set that search up there and start it again. The panel has an "Open another DAT tab" button for this.
- Should I keep working in the tab Auto Emailer is running in? No. Leave it alone while it runs: scrolling, clicking rows or opening load details pauses the board refresh, so fresh postings stop coming through. Keep a second DAT tab for your own searching and let the watching tab sit untouched in the background.
- Can I send from Outlook? Yes. Sign in with Microsoft to send from Outlook.com or a Microsoft 365 work mailbox; Gmail and Google Workspace are supported too.
- Can I use more than one email address? Yes. You can connect several Gmail or Outlook mailboxes, each with its own templates, name and MC.
- Does Truck Box read my email? No. It has send-only access (Gmail gmail.send, Microsoft Mail.Send), so it technically cannot open or read your inbox. It only sends the emails you choose to send, and you can revoke access anytime in your Google or Microsoft account.
- Is Truck Box safe? Yes. It uses official Google and Microsoft sign-in, requests only permission to send email, never sees your passwords, and only works with load details already shown on the page you are viewing.
- How do I choose which address an email is sent from? Each template is tied to one sender. Pick it in the extension popup (Template → Send from), or switch templates for a single load from the menu next to the email button.
- Can I log in with both Google and Microsoft? Yes. Link both logins in the back office (Accounts) and either one opens the same account, subscription, templates and mailboxes.
- Why can't I send from my Outlook address? Usually the Microsoft account has no Outlook mailbox (for example a work account without an Exchange license, or a personal Microsoft account made with a Gmail address). Use an account with an Outlook inbox, or reconnect a mailbox marked Disconnected in the back office.
- Does it work out tolls? Yes. In the profit calculator, one click estimates the tolls for that lane for a standard 5-axle tractor-trailer, and you can type over the figure if you know better. Diesel fills in the same way from the national average.
- Which factoring companies are supported? RTS Financial, Triumph and Apex Capital. You need your own active account with one of them.
- How do I cancel? Cancel anytime from your billing page in one click. You keep access until the end of the paid period and are not charged again.
- How do I update the extension? Chrome updates extensions automatically. To update right away, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer Mode and press Update. The Guide has screenshots.
- Something isn't working, what should I try? Update the extension, log out and back in from the Truck Box popup, then refresh the DAT or Truckstop page (F5). If it still fails, use the chat on truckbox.app.
- Is there a plan for companies? Yes. Teams pay $7 per seat per month on one bill and get a manager back office. Sign up at https://truckbox.app/business/start.
